name: ratchet
description: Compare pytest failure records and recover their original evidence in shadow mode.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect repeated failures without losing the evidence.
interface.longDescription: Experimental read-only failure comparison. Inspect scoped pytest records, distinguish observed blocker changes, and recover exact originals. Shadow mode is the default; no command blocking or demonstrated savings.
defaultPrompt: Compare these two pytest attempts with Ratchet.
Show the evidence behind this Ratchet comparison.
